sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-29 and 2016-12-29, cardholder C11923 experienced unauthorized activity on card C11923-K2. A total of 1 transaction(s) amounting to $131.30 USD were executed under fraud pattern 'card_testing'. The primary flagged transaction 3583368 ($131.30) was initiated through the online channel. Activity originated from a device profile (SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | UnknownOS | chrome 66.0 for android | UnknownScreen) marked as New for this account. The same device profile was also observed across 4 other distinct cards, demonstrating coordinated compromise. The cardholder was contacted for transaction validation and stated: 'Customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the card'. The activity represents a coordinated breach consistent with regulatory typology guidance. The financial institution has blocked card C11923-K2 to mitigate further loss and placed linked accounts under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Customer denial and definitive graph pattern signatures settled the verdict; further steps would not alter the defensive actions.
